product_metadata.title: Clima Balance - Lightweight All Year Down Alternative Comforter Full - Breathable Patented Design - Increases Deep Sleep Phases up to 50% - Sensofill Virgin Polyester - Full 80" x 90"
features: A PERFECT CHOICE: Enjoying a refreshing, comfortable night sleep without having to deal with unpleasant perspiration and night sweats is now possible with the ClimaBalance down alternative comforter, an innovative solution that uses cutting-edge fabrics to regulate and maintain optimal body temperature all throughout the night! "DUE TO CLIMABALANCE TECHNOLOGY THE TEAMS REGENERATION HAS IMPROVED AS SLEEP QUALITY AND SLEEP TIME INCREASED" - Jogi Löw (German National Soccer Coach)

INNOVATION IS KEY: This full size comforter is made with hi-tech mesh fabric, an adaptable material which transports excess heat and adjusts your body temperature no matter the season. Based on multiple climate zones that work as pockets, this comforter balances cooler air to the same temperature as your body during the winter, while preventing perspiration and heat discomfort during hot days! Tested and developed together with numerous independent universities.
MADE FOR YOU: Our soft comforter is made from premium microfiber materials. The filling is ultra-lightweight, fluffy and distributed evenly for a pampering experience.

EASY MAINTENANCE: Unlike similar products on the market, the ClimaBalance fluffy white comforter is machine washable at gentle cycle and easy to care, without the added expense of dry cleaning or special maintenance.

IMPROVED SLEEP: The ClimaBalance full bed comforter can be used as a duvet insert or stand-alone comforter, minimizing the need of moving by regulating humidity and heat. Extensively tested and developed by leading sleep researchers, our comforter improves sleep quality by increasing REM phases. An ideal choice for the entire family, and for people with sleeping disorders or insomnia!
